# V4 correction-conditioned evidence routing: source development screen

**REAL source-development evidence:** Transport loses to posterior by 0.2080 degrees and to the generic action control by 0.0720 degrees at the primary step-2 endpoint. The proposed transport mechanism has not established a gain; prefer posterior for the next accuracy gate. These scores reuse the same 119-image validation set for checkpoint selection and reporting, use one seed, and are not an independent benchmark.

## Scope and protocol

The three 3.097M-parameter modes used the same scratch MobileNetV3-large feature encoder, source cache, 1,126 training images, 119 capture-group-disjoint validation images, seed 17, batch 32, 120 epochs, optimizer, augmentations, action samples, loss schedule and 25/51/103-query search. Posterior holds evidence weights fixed over actions; action supplies generic relative action; transport explicitly recomputes corrected-simplex local evidence. The model never receives filenames, GT, camera identity or EXIF at inference.

The source-input validity receipt separately checked all 1,126 training and 119 validation images and found zero nonfinite, negative, all-black or absent-channel rows. The three same-seed validation histories diverge at epoch 1, before the field loss activates. CUDA deterministic algorithms were not enabled, so identical initialization, budgets and RNG seed did not produce bitwise matched training. With one run per mode, the observed gaps are screening outcomes, not stable causal effect estimates; the next comparison needs a paired starting checkpoint and multiple seeds.

The generator verified every immutable run manifest entry, exact code/data/role/budget equality, epoch 0-120 histories, and both checkpoint selection rules. It independently rebuilt predictions from saved float32 log actions, converted source GT through float32 exactly as the runner did, and recomputed recovery/reproduction angles with NumPy `atan2` in float64. Every saved per-image error and aggregate checked within 1e-6 degree.

Timing, when present, is synchronized batch-one FP32 on device-resident 128x128 RGB, including one encoder pass and all candidate queries; it excludes decode, disk, host-device upload and image rendering. Direct point-only latency was not measured in this benchmark. Host timing is variable: the primary action stage-2 median is anomalously above its own stage-4 median, so these measurements do not support an architecture-overhead inference.

## Evidence boundary

This is SimpleCube++ CC BY 4.0 source-validation evidence from 1,126 training and 119 repeatedly used development-validation images, one seed. It does not evaluate the official source test/risk/calibration roles, any new camera population, INTEL-TAU, facial images, skin color, CIELAB/DeltaE, C+ calibration, universal accuracy, novelty, patentability or production readiness. Dense candidate actions reuse the same two GT coordinates and are not independent samples. The generated archive excludes weights and images; its copied run manifests retain hashes for `best.pt`, `best_point.pt` and `last.pt` so checkpoint identities remain auditable.
